evals.prompt: I do not see a .cursor folder or a .claude folder in this repo. How mature is the editor setup?
evals.expected_output: Says the editor setup is not in the project. Does not create a folder.
assertions: Says the editor setup is not in the project

evals.prompt: There is a .cursor folder. I do not see mcp.json. I do not see any SKILL.md files.
evals.expected_output: Says the .cursor folder is present, MCP is not connected, and there are no skills. Does not create mcp.json.

evals.prompt: .cursor/mcp.json exists. .cursor/skills/billing/SKILL.md is ours. .agents/skills/infisical/SKILL.md was installed from a library. Do not show me the MCP tokens.
evals.expected_output: Says MCP is connected. Says billing is a skill they defined and infisical is imported. Does not print a token. Says their own skills are the more mature setup.
assertions: Says billing is a skill they defined
Says their own skills are the more mature setup

evals.prompt: There is a .claude folder and a .cursor folder. The only SKILL.md files are under .agents/skills/.
evals.expected_output: Says both Cursor and Claude folders are present. Says the skills are imported and none are defined in this project.
assertions: Says both Cursor and Claude folders are present
Says none are defined in this project

evals.prompt: mcp.json has a sentry server. Is that MCP used, and can we go deeper?
evals.expected_output: Uses the sentry skill. Does not list servers, URLs, or tokens.
assertions: Does not list servers, URLs, or tokens
